name: shipstatic
description: Deploy static websites, landing pages, and prototypes instantly. Free, no account needed.

interface.longDescription: Ask your agent to put what you made online, and ShipStatic publishes it. A build folder goes up from disk, and a page the agent writes goes up as it is. You get a link you can share right away, and you don't need an account. A site published without one stays up for 3 days, and its claim link lets you keep it. Want it private? Ask for built-in password protection.
capabilities: Publish a site with no account
Get a link to share right away
Protect a site with a password
defaultPrompt: Build this project and publish it with ShipStatic.
Make a one-page site for my bakery and give me a link I can share.
Publish the dist folder with ShipStatic's built-in password protection.
